newsitem.title: USA: S. Carolina jobless rate rises to 6.1 pct in Oct..
newsitem.headline: S. Carolina jobless rate rises to 6.1 pct in Oct..

text.p: South Carolina's unemployment rate rose to 6.1 percent in October from 5.9 percent in September, the state Employment Security Commission said Wednesday.
Job losses were seen in trade and tourist-related industries, probably due to unseasonably cool weahter, the commission's executive director, Joel Cassidy, said.

Manufacturing, transportation and public utility employment was steady. Total nonfarm employment rose by 2,300 to 1.7 million in October, mainly due to the recall of nonfaculty personnel at schools and colleges.
Williamsburg County had the state's highest unemployment rate, 19.2 percent, and Beaufort County had the lowest, 3 percent.
